nodes.text: Let $g(n)$ denote the number of groups of order $n$. If $n\leq 2^m$ then $g(n)\leq g(2^m)$.

#1160 : [Va99,5.71] group theory This is listed as an open problem (Question 22.16) in [BNV07] , which reports it as a 'quite natural conjecture, whose origin we have been unable to trace satisfactorily. We have heard it attributed at various times to various people, such as Paul Erdős and Graham Higman.' Question 22.18 of [BNV07] suggests the even stronger conjecture\[\sum_{n<2^m}g(n) \leq g(2^m)\]for all sufficiently large $m$ (perhaps even as soon as $m\geq 7$). Pantelidakis [Pa03] proved that the original conjecture is true if $n$ is odd and $m\geq 3619$.
